text:
```yaml
name: Build Release

on:
  release:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  build-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build assets
        run: npm run build

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: actions/setup-php@v5
        with:
          php-version: '8.3'

      - name: Install PHP dependencies
        uses: ramsey/composer-install@v3
        with:
          composer-options: '--no-dev --optimize-autoloader --prefer-dist --no-interaction'
          working-directory: .
          require-lock-file: true

      - name: Prepare distribution directory
        run: |
          mkdir -p plugin
          rsync -av --exclude-from=.distignore --exclude='.distignore' ./ plugin/

      - name: Create zip
        run: |
          zip -r pressforward-${{ github.ref_name }}.zip plugin

      - name: Install GitHub CLI
        uses: cli/cli@v2

      - name: Upload release asset
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh release upload ${{ github.ref_name }} pressforward-${{ github.ref_name }}.zip --repo ${{ github.repository }}
```
